sections.title: 主要结果
sections.text:
《Scientific assessment of oral nicotine pouches and associated risk reduction in comparison to combustible cigarettes》：结果的原文依据；数值与适用人群以引文为准。

【Abstract · abstract-1-6】Chemical studies find fewer toxicants, lower levels than both cigarette smoke and snus, and generally similar to levels in NRT products.

【Abstract · abstract-1-7】In vitro toxicological studies find little evidence of mutagenicity or genotoxicity in ONP extracts, and generally lower biological activity than snus extracts.

evidence.text: Chemical studies find fewer toxicants, lower levels than both cigarette smoke and snus, and generally similar to levels in NRT products.
In vitro toxicological studies find little evidence of mutagenicity or genotoxicity in ONP extracts, and generally lower biological activity than snus extracts.
